3113358.findings: Three Tasmanian brown and amber streaky glazed vases. Two bases incised in script 'H McHugh Tasmania' (one numbered 3), confirming Harold McHugh (Launceston) attribution; third (small bulbous vase) has a blue painted mark on a crazed base and number, not clearly McHugh. Title claim of McHugh is supported.
